description: This Java class, CurrencyDaoImpl, is an implementation of the CurrencyDao interface. It extends a generic DAO implementation for handling Currency entities and provides a method to list all Currency objects ordered by their code. It leverages QueryDSL for constructing the JPA query.

classes.name: CurrencyDaoImpl
classes.description: A DAO implementation class for Currency entities, providing data access methods such as listing currencies.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all Currency objects ordered by their code.
